description: Does the change make something move differently, so a still picture would not show it?
instructions: Does the change make something move, appear, disappear, scroll, rotate, fold, present or respond to a gesture differently over time, so a still picture would not show it?

criteria.true: Animation, transition, gesture, scroll behaviour, rotation or fold behaviour, sheet presentation, or something a person feels as smoother or faster
criteria.false: What changes can be seen in one frame, or nothing visible changes

output: pr_visual select: recorded under jev_shadow; a yes with no clip becomes Visuals Missing once measured.
